name: Convatec (180 Medical) (Partner)
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: High school diploma or GED required. Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred but not required.
 Required Experience: 1+ years of sales/customer service experience. Proven call center and/or tele-sales experience.
 Preferred Experience: Bilingual English/Spanish. Sales experience specifically. Previous healthcare or customer service background.
 Required Skills:
Structured, efficient handling of inbound/outbound campaigns
Strong verbal and written communication with excellent phone etiquette
Genuine patience and empathy, especially for ostomy patients
Ability to precisely follow instructions and structured processes
Results-oriented with natural rapport-building ability
Comfort with computer-based contact/database management systems
Best Fit
This role is ideal for:
Someone with call center or tele-sales experience who wants a genuinely healthcare-focused sales role
Participants who can balance real empathy with meeting monthly sales and activity targets
Anyone comfortable having sensitive conversations about medical conditions (ostomy, continence) with compassion
People who want a structured, campaign-based outbound/inbound calling role
Not a Good Fit for:
Participants without at least 1 year of sales or customer service experience
Someone who would struggle balancing genuine care with active sales pressure
Anyone uncomfortable discussing sensitive medical topics compassionately and directly
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Consumer engagement
Healthcare sales
Tele-sales
Ostomy/chronic condition products
Inbound and outbound campaigns
Customer relationship building
Sales target achievement
Empathetic communication
Database/CRM management
Patient support
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
Application
Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you.
If assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen.
If phone screen passes you can expect the final interview.
 Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3-15 days on average.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell me about a time you balanced genuine customer care with meeting a sales goal.
How do you approach a sensitive conversation about a medical condition with empathy and professionalism?
Describe your experience with structured, campaign-based outbound calling.
How do you stay motivated hitting monthly sales and activity targets?
What draws you to working in the ostomy/chronic condition care space specifically?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:

-Pay: Est. $20/hr base ($42,594/yr) plus a sales incentive plan. The posting does not list pay, so this is an estimate. Confirm directly during the recruiter screen.

-Shift: Full-time, remote. Must have availability for any shift based on business needs. Can be discussed in final interview, offer stage.

-Benefits: Not detailed in this specific posting. Basic benefits: insurance options, PTO, possible 401k.

-Equipment Provided: Yes.

-Felony Friendly? Not stated in posting or found in outside research specific to Convatec.

-Drug Test: Not stated in posting.

-Notes: Oklahoma City is listed as an eligible location. The posting says to apply by November 7, 2026. This role is both inbound and outbound calling with monthly sales targets, so it is a sales role in a healthcare setting. This posting includes a direct fraud/scam warning: a formal interview process confirmed by an official Convatec email address is required before any offer, and Convatec will never ask for personal information or fees during recruitment. Worth passing along to participants as a scam-awareness reminder.

-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Client Engagement Specialist → Senior Client Engagement Specialist → Client Engagement Team Lead → Client Engagement Supervisor → Consumer Marketing or Sales Manager.
